items.title: Boston Scientific (BSX) Is Back In The Spotlight, What Is Driving Attention?
items.summary: Boston Scientific (BSX) is back in focus after a series of voluntary Class II recalls for its Direxion Torqueable Microcatheter lines, raising questions about quality control, regulatory exposure, and how much risk is now priced into the stock. Recent recall headlines have landed on a stock that was already under pressure.
